title: The go install route leaves the tool version at dev, and INSTALL did not say so
foundBy: session agent, following README.md and INSTALL.md as a first-time reader

evidence.verified: Installed with `go install …@latest` into a scratch GOPATH: the binary printed `cs-ledger dev (renderer 0.3.2, ui tokens 1.12.0)`.

details:
INSTALL.md offers `go install github.com/codesweep-ai/ledger/cmd/cs-ledger@latest`, then says "However you got it, check what you installed" and shows `cs-ledger version`.

That build prints `cs-ledger dev (renderer 0.3.2, ui tokens 1.12.0)`, because the stamp comes from the Makefile's ldflags. A reader who takes the middle route and follows the next instruction sees a word the page never mentioned.
